points.heading: Deepen: one-word times
points.body:
Today we stay on **one-word** times only (no haber). Remember the thread: verb = action; conjugate = change for who and when; stem = fixed part; ending = tip. With those four ideas you can rebuild any simple form. This deepen day is your chance to hear the five clocks without the helper **haber** getting in the way. Walk the five clocks as one story: **canto** now, **cantaba** as open past, **canté** as closed past, **cantaré** ahead, **cantaría** as «would.» The helpful contrast is **cantaba** (leaves the moment open) versus **canté** (closes it). When I was little I **cantaba** in the shower every day; yesterday I **canté** once at the school concert—that night was finished.

Compare two short examples out loud. Say what changes and what stays the same. Write one sentence in your own words before you start the practice task.

Practice: Now it's your turn. Práctica: Ahora te toca a ti.

Common mistake: Error común:
